traversal_stages.required_check: selection, canonical position, and representation identity survive round trip

hard_invariants: Canonical body/feature positions are unchanged by camera-origin changes.
Coordinate-frame mismatch is rejected until the caller applies a verified transform.
Selected or task-critical content is not removed solely because apparent size is small.
Presentation hierarchy preserves stable semantic identity through proxy/tile substitutions.
Unloaded or unavailable content is not silently treated as nonexistent.
Ephemeris-backed and illustrative content is explicitly distinguished.
Projected-error claims are only made when mesh-error and camera assumptions are supplied and validated.

Every benchmark receipt binds exact source revision, fixture digest, camera path, render resolution, settings, shader revision, adapter/backend, driver, operating system, and reference-frame/epoch metadata.

claim_ceiling: This manifest is a workload contract, not a rendered result.
CPU coordinate microbenchmarks do not prove GPU precision or frame-time performance.
Analytic apparent-sphere values do not replace authoritative ephemeris or actual limb geometry.
No superiority claim over Gaia Sky, Cesium, Unreal Engine, Unity, or other engines is authorized without matched reproducible comparisons.

hard_invariants: child assets are not required to refine

hierarchy_selection_cases.expected: render child representations and not parent
